context: M16 o4. Kallis Fur Salon. Kallis pours two coffees. Neither drinks.

lines.speaker: char.stavros_kallis
lines.text: Niko. I offer you a fair price. Fair for July.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: You want my firm for the price of a winter coat.

lines.speaker: char.stavros_kallis
lines.text: I want your crew. Yiannis especially. The firm comes with them, sadly.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I nailed skins for your uncle in forty-eight. I remember your prices.
